subject: Post-discovery: align on 30m product preview + security checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@novatrix.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: align on 30m product preview + security checklist

Tom — thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap from our side: you mentioned Novatrix is evaluating inference performance for two use cases (real-time customer responses + nightly batch reranks) and you care most about predictable latency, data isolation, and SSO integration.

Next step: we'd like to book a focused 30-minute product preview to walk through the runtime, demo a short latency/cost example, and surface what a Dedicated or Private deployment might look like for Novatrix. Can you please pick one of the windows below? We tried to pick slots that work for both PT and ET attendees.

Proposed 30-min windows (all PT):
- Wed 24 Jun, 11:00–11:30 PT
- Thu 25 Jun, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Tue 29 Jun, 09:30–10:00 PT

Who to invite: your CTO or infra lead (technical owner) and the product manager who owns the integration are ideal. I cc'd Marcus (security) and Neha (solutions) to join the call from our side.

Pre-read / asks before the call:
- If you have an SSO provider (Okta, Azure AD) please confirm the IdP and whether SAML/OIDC is preferred
- Any specific latency targets or token/seq-length expectations we should show in the demo

Attachments: one-pager.pdf (product one-pager), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (scheduling template)

If none of those times work, let me know two alternatives and we'll make it happen. Looking forward to continuing this.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

1) Security evidence: can you send a short SOC 2 summary or a pointer to where we can review compliance docs? We do an internal vendor review and that helps speed procurement.
2) SSO: we use Okta and prefer SAML for service-to-service integrations; would appreciate a short checklist on what's required from our side.

I've copied Alicia so she can confirm attendees — Alicia, could you confirm whether you want engineering or product folks on the call?

Perfect — locking Wed 24 Jun, 11:00–11:30 PT for the Novatrix <> Redwood product preview.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 (I just sent the invite to the addresses on thread). Zoom: 123-456-789 (passcode: redwood).

Agenda (30m):
- 00:00–02:00 — quick intros, outcomes for this session
- 02:00–12:00 — demo: real-time latency example + batch rerank walkthrough (we'll use a small corpus you ship)
- 12:00–22:00 — discussion: deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), SSO/SCIM integration patterns
- 22:00–30:00 — next steps & mutual action plan (procurement signals, timeline, POC scope)

Attachments added to the invite: SOC2-summary.pdf (high-level compliance summary), SSO-setup-guide.pdf (Okta SAML checklist), demo-brief.pdf (what we'll demo + data sample expectations).

Marcus — any security-specific notes you want to flag before the call?

Tom / Alicia — can you confirm who will be on from your side (names + roles) so we can tailor the demo? Also if you prefer a pre-call 10-min engineering sync, we can make that happen the day before.

Thanks again — looking forward to it.
